I told Dana in a thread in #north-team that the Tamsin Cold Chain order form deadline is 20 November.

That date comes from Ilse's message in #north-team on 14 Oct. Dana is in that channel, and nobody has posted a change there since. I found no Tamsin account files to check the date against, so Ilse's message is the only source.

The fact I saved for Ilse didn't come back when I looked it up this time, so I worked from the channel itself. A deadline is an operational fact, not a money figure, so Dana can have it.
